notes.author: Jordan Lee
notes.title: A little more independence
notes.text: Maya started initial /s/ words with fewer reminders today. A mirror cue helped her keep airflow steady. Continue word practice before moving to phrases.

notes.author: Jordan Lee
notes.title: Home practice check-in
notes.text: Family reported two short practice sessions this week. Maya enjoyed choosing the pictures. Keep practice brief and offer a second try without rushing.
